steps.title: A Rust function behind a button
steps.titleZh: 按钮背后的 Rust 函数
steps.text: `rust/src/lib.rs` defines one function, `add(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32`. `extern "C"` and `#[unsafe(no_mangle)]` export it under its plain name, so JavaScript can find it. `npm run build:wasm` compiles it to `add.wasm`, a WebAssembly module: a compact binary the browser runs next to JavaScript. The two boxes hold the arguments, 2 and 3.
steps.textZh: `rust/src/lib.rs` 只定义了一个函数：`add(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32`。`extern "C"` 和 `#[unsafe(no_mangle)]` 让它以原本的名字导出，JavaScript 才能找到它。`npm run build:wasm` 把它编译成 `add.wasm`，也就是一个 WebAssembly 模块：浏览器可以和 JavaScript 放在一起运行的紧凑二进制文件。两个输入框里是参数：2 和 3。

steps.title: Call it
steps.text: On the first click, `main.js` fetches `add.wasm`, turns it into a module with `WebAssembly.instantiate`, and then calls `module.instance.exports.add(a, b)` with the two numbers, like any other function. Only plain numbers cross between JavaScript and Wasm, so no generated glue code is needed. With the module built, the page shows `5`. Without it, for example when you run the page before `npm run build:wasm`, the fetch fails and the page says `Build the Rust module with npm run build:wasm` instead.
steps.textZh: 第一次点击时，`main.js` 取回 `add.wasm`，用 `WebAssembly.instantiate` 把它变成模块，然后把两个数传给 `module.instance.exports.add(a, b)`，像调用普通函数一样。在 JavaScript 和 Wasm 之间传递的只有普通数字，所以不需要生成任何“胶水”代码。模块已经构建好时，页面显示 `5`。如果还没有构建，比如在运行 `npm run build:wasm` 之前就打开了页面，取回会失败，页面改为显示 `Build the Rust module with npm run build:wasm`。

steps.title: Past the largest i32
steps.titleZh: 超过 i32 的最大值
steps.text: An `i32` holds whole numbers from `-2147483648` to `2147483647`. `add` uses `wrapping_add`, so going past the largest one wraps around, on purpose and in every build: `2147483647 + 3` gives `-2147483646`. The README's example, `2147483647 + 1`, gives the smallest `i32`, `-2147483648`. Without the module, the page shows the build hint again.
steps.textZh: `i32` 能存放从 `-2147483648` 到 `2147483647` 的整数。`add` 用的是 `wrapping_add`，所以超过最大值时会绕回，这是有意为之，而且在任何构建方式下都一样：`2147483647 + 3` 得到 `-2147483646`。README 里的例子 `2147483647 + 1` 则得到最小的 `i32`，也就是 `-2147483648`。如果还没有构建模块，页面会再次显示构建提示。

steps.title: Numbers Rust cannot take
steps.text: `main.js` checks both boxes before it calls Rust. `1.5` is not a whole number, so the page says `Enter signed 32-bit integers`, and `add` is never called. A number outside the `i32` range, such as `2147483648`, gets the same answer. This check runs before the module is fetched, so it works even when the module has not been built.
steps.textZh: `main.js` 在调用 Rust 之前会先检查两个输入框。`1.5` 不是整数，所以页面显示 `Enter signed 32-bit integers`，`add` 根本不会被调用。超出 `i32` 范围的数，比如 `2147483648`，也会得到同样的提示。这项检查在取回模块之前进行，所以即使还没有构建模块也能用。
